feature_name: Model Context Protocol (MCP) support in API hub
summary: Adds MCP as a first-class API style in API hub, including registration, management, and tool extraction for MCP APIs.
extended_definition: Adds MCP as a first-class API style in API hub, including registration, management, and tool extraction for MCP APIs.
